prompt: When a mirrored upstream repository is marked as permanently broken and suspended, existing users with cached access can still mint tokens for it and a background worker can still mint fetch tokens against it. Suspension only stops the next reconciler pass, not live token issuance, so the door stays open at token exchange. Make the token-exchange lookups treat suspended placements as not found so no new tokens can be minted for them. Keep the fix minimal.

suspended placement still minting tokens auth gate
reconciler MarkSuspended only stops next pass
cached repo access edges mint mirror token revoked upstream
mirror worker fetch token suspended upstream
